例句

  1. If city life gives you stress and fatigue, it is best to relax in the mountains or on beaches in order to relieve them.
    如果城市生活讓你壓力大又疲倦，最好去山上或海邊放鬆，消除這些壓力和疲勞。
  2. My aunt gave me a book.
    我阿姨給了我一本書。
  3. Please give this letter to your father.
    請把這封信交給你爸爸。
  4. This music gives me energy.
    這首音樂讓我很有精神。
  5. The trip gave us a lot of good memories.
    這趟旅行給了我們很多美好的回憶。
  6. The teacher gave each student a dictionary.
    老師給每個學生一本字典。
  7. Too much homework gives me a headache.
    太多作業讓我頭痛。
  8. Tom gave his old bike to his cousin.
    Tom 把他的舊腳踏車給了他表弟。
  9. It is best to go early in the morning.
    最好一早就去。
  10. It is better to take the train than to drive.
    搭火車比開車好。
  11. It is best to drink a lot of water when you have a cold.
    感冒的時候最好多喝水。
  12. When you visit Kyoto, it is best to stay near the station.
    你去京都的時候，最好住在車站附近。
  13. It is better to ask the teacher than to guess.
    問老師比用猜的好。
  14. It is best not to eat too much before bed.
    睡前最好不要吃太多。
  15. It is best not to swim right after lunch.
    午餐後最好不要馬上游泳。
  16. We booked early in order to get cheap tickets.
    為了買到便宜的票，我們提早訂票。
  17. We closed the door quietly in order not to wake the baby.
    我們輕輕關上門，以免吵醒小嬰兒。
  18. She saves money in order to study abroad.
    她為了出國讀書而存錢。
  19. Many people go to the hot springs in order to relax.
    很多人為了放鬆而去泡溫泉。
  20. He set two alarms in order not to oversleep.
    他設了兩個鬧鐘，以免睡過頭。
  21. I write down new words in order to remember them.
    為了記住新單字，我把它們寫下來。
  22. If work gives you stress, it is best to take a short walk.
    如果工作帶給你壓力，最好去散一下步。
  23. Long flights give me a backache.
    長途飛行讓我背痛。
  24. My grandmother goes to the mountains every summer in order to escape the heat.
    為了避暑，我奶奶每年夏天都去山上。
  25. It is best to leave early in order to avoid the traffic.
    最好早點出發，才能避開車潮。
  26. Please give me a call when you arrive.
    你到的時候請打電話給我。
  27. It is better to start now than to wait until tomorrow.
    現在開始比等到明天好。
  28. We went to the beach in order to relax after the exams.
    考試之後我們為了放鬆去了海邊。
  29. Ann studied hard in order not to fail the test.
    Ann 為了不要考不及格而努力讀書。
  30. My neighbor gave me a ride to the station.
    我鄰居開車載我到車站。
  31. It is best to visit Hokkaido in winter if you want to see snow.
    如果你想看雪，最好冬天去北海道。
  32. If you feel tired, take a break.
    如果你覺得累，就休息一下。
  33. If the weather is nice this weekend, we'll go hiking.
    如果這個週末天氣好，我們就去爬山。
  34. If you need help, call me anytime.
    如果你需要幫忙，隨時打給我。
  35. If my little brother doesn't get enough sleep, he gets angry easily.
    如果我弟弟睡不夠，他就很容易生氣。
  36. If you leave now, you'll get there before dark.
    如果你現在出發，天黑前就會到。
  37. If Ann feels nervous, she talks very fast.
    如果 Ann 覺得緊張，她說話就會很快。
